stage0_note: The combination ledger is empty. The finding that shapes the page came from the component record: MOTS-c has 277 indexed publications and thirteen human rows, and every one of those rows measures circulating MOTS-c in people rather than giving anyone a dose. The same measured-not-given pattern was found on humanin, LL-37 and kisspeptin.

Those belong to the compound's own written record and are redirected. The Ads volume against zero clickstream for the stack is the signature of a product being marketed ahead of its audience.
h1: Retatrutide with MOTS-c: no study has tested the pair, and none has ever given MOTS-c to a person
dek: The stack pairs an investigational triple agonist with a mitochondrial peptide that has 277 publications and no human dosing study. Its entire human literature measures the MOTS-c people already have in their blood. That is a different thing from a drug, and it is the thing this pairing assumes.

information_gain: The only page on this query to check what MOTS-c's human evidence is. Thirteen human studies sit in its record and every one of them measured circulating MOTS-c by immunoassay: levels after exercise, levels in people with thyroid disease, levels in dialysate, levels that did not change over 24 weeks of an intervention. None gave MOTS-c to anyone. The human dosing evidence that does exist belongs to CB4211, an analogue, in a phase 1 trial. So the stack combines a drug that cannot be obtained legally with a compound that has never been administered to a person in a published study, and the incumbent page that ranks second for this query, which is careful enough to say three times that no trial has tested the combination, prints twelve tables of dosing without noticing the second half. The page also records the one structural fact the incumbent gets right and everyone else omits: the two cannot be pre-blended, because their post-reconstitution storage limits differ.
serp_format_rewarded: A page that reads the component literature. The incumbent ranks second with 7,846 words and twelve tables; it is beatable only on what the evidence actually is, not on length.
open_actions: CB4211's phase 1 trial is not in this ledger; the statement that human dosing evidence belongs to an analogue is editorial with pending_source.
MOTS-c's own record carries the measured-not-given distinction and takes the component queries.
Retatrutide's phase 3 programme is unpublished; the comparison pages carry that detail.
